title: Imirimo y'itsinda ry'ubuvuzi
subtitle: Imirimo yo gukurikirana muri {{facility}}: gushinga abajyanama b'ubuzima bemewe, gukurikirana guhura n'umurwayi no kwemeza irangizwa rifite ibimenyetso.
overdueHint: Byabazwe uhereye ku itariki umuntu yashyizeho. Si itegeko ry'igihe cy'ubuvuzi.

empty.unassigned: Imirimo yose ifunguye muri {{facility}} ifite umujyanama w'ubuzima
empty.unableToReach: Nta mirimo yanditswe ko umurwayi atabonetse

workload.title: Akazi k'abajyanama b'ubuzima
workload.body: Imirimo ifunguye n'iyarengeje igihe kuri buri mujyanama w'ubuzima wemewe, kugira ngo akazi kagabanywe neza.
workload.empty: Nta bajyanama b'ubuzima bemewe muri iki kigo.

dialog.failed: Ibyo wanditse byagumyeho. Ongera ugerageze — hoherezwa icyifuzo kimwe, nta kibikwa kabiri.

errors.invalidTransition: Iyi ntambwe ntigishoboka kuri uyu murimo. Funga uwufungure kugira ngo urebe uko uhagaze ubu.
errors.workerNotAuthorised: Uyu mujyanama w'ubuzima ntiyemerewe muri iki kigo. Hitamo umujyanama uri ku rutonde.

assign.title: Shinga umurimo
assign.body: Hitamo umujyanama w'ubuzima wemewe w'iki kigo.
assign.reassignBody: Ubu wahawe {{name}}. Uwari awufite agumaho mu mateka y'umurimo.
assign.workerHint: Hagaragara gusa abajyanama b'ubuzima bemewe b'iki kigo, n'akazi bafite ubu.
assign.dueHint: Igaragara mu isaha ya Kigali. Igomba kuba nyuma y'ubu.

hint.unable_to_reach: Umurwayi ntiyabonetse. Umurimo ushobora guhabwa undi.

complete.title: Andika irangizwa
complete.body: Irangizwa rikenera igihe, umusaruro n'ubwoko bw'ikimenyetso.
complete.notEvidence: Kohereza urwibutso cyangwa ubutumwa si ikimenyetso cy'uko gukurikirana kwabaye.

confirm.title: Suzuma irangizwa ryavuzwe
confirm.body: Umujyanama w'ubuzima yavuze ko uyu murimo warangiye. Wemeze, cyangwa uwusubize umujyanama ufite impamvu.

returnToWorker.title: Subiza umurimo umujyanama
returnToWorker.body: Umurimo usubira ku mujyanama nk'uwavuganywe. Sobanura ikibura.

note.title: Ongeraho icyitonderwa
note.body: Ibyitonderwa byongerwa mu mateka y'umurimo kandi ntibishobora guhindurwa nyuma.
note.label: Icyitonderwa

create.title: Kora umurimo
create.body: Kora umurimo wo gukurikirana ku isuzuma ryafatiwe icyemezo. Umurimo umwe ufunguye wa buri bwoko ku isuzuma.
create.none: Nta suzuma ryafatiwe icyemezo rikeneye umurimo mushya.

drawer.title: Umurimo
drawer.description: Ibisobanuro, amateka n'ibikorwa by'umurimo wo gukurikirana.
drawer.denied: Uyu murimo ni uw'ikindi kigo kandi ntushobora gufungurirwa hano. Igerageza ryanditswe.
drawer.newerVersion: Undi muntu yabitse verisiyo nshya y'uyu murimo (verisiyo {{version}}). Uracyareba verisiyo wafunguye.
drawer.wf02Hint: Igerageza: kugira ngo urebe uguhangana kwa verisiyo, fungura Igenamiterere mu yindi tab uhitemo “Igana umujyanama uvugurura gukurikirana”, hanyuma ugaruke ubike impinduka hano.
drawer.offline: Nta murandasi (igerageza). Impinduka zahagaritswe; umurimo uracyasomeka.
drawer.noPermission: Uruhare rwawe rushobora kongeraho ibyitonderwa ariko ntirushobora gushinga cyangwa kurangiza imirimo.

conflict.title: Uyu murimo wahindutse mu gihe wakoraga
conflict.body: Undi muntu yabitse uyu murimo nyuma y'uko uwufungura. Nta kintu cyasimbujwe. Hitamo icyo gukora.
conflict.reapply: Ongera ushyire impinduka yanjye ku iheruka
conflict.reapplyBlocked: Impinduka yawe ntigihuye na verisiyo iheruka. Gumana iheruka wongere utangire.
conflict.previewTitle: Ongera ushyire impinduka yawe kuri verisiyo iheruka?
conflict.previewBody: Impinduka yawe izabikwa kuri verisiyo {{version}}. Reba uko bizaba:

corrections.title: Ibisabwa byo gukosora inyandiko
corrections.body: Ibyo abarwayi basaba ko hasuzumwa ikintu mu nyandiko yabo. Gukemura icyifuzo ntibihindura inyandiko ubwayo.
corrections.resolveBody: Hitamo umusaruro. Umurwayi abona amagambo yemejwe, ntabwo abona inyandiko yanditswe n'abakozi.
corrections.outcomeHint: Ikosora nyaryo ry'inyandiko rikorwa ukwaryo (rifite impamvu).
corrections.conflict: Iki cyifuzo cyahinduwe n'undi muntu. Ongera ufungure urupapuro wongere ugerageze.

toast.keptLatest: Hagumyeho verisiyo iheruka — impinduka yawe ntiyabitswe
toast.reapplied: Impinduka yawe yabitswe kuri verisiyo iheruka
